**Needs changes before merge.**

This is a SAFETY-tier review. The PR adds new posted G-code, a new verify mode (`Mode::Carve`) and new geometry.

### What looks good

- The kernel modules have provenance heads that name published sources. No vendor material is named. Each new file is under 400 lines.
- The kernel validates its parameters by name. It refuses an empty region, a loop with fewer than three points and an edge of no length. It has a work budget. I found no `unwrap()`, `expect()` or `panic!()` outside tests.
- Each straight feed move is checked against the outline before it is written. A failed check becomes a retract and a new plunge.
- The kind tag (44), `ALL[44]` and the project-file arm are appends. The `OpType` declaration is at the end of the enum.
- The MCP surface uses the generic `add_operation` tool. The MCP test creates, generates, verifies, posts and undoes the operation.
- The golden `crates/app/tests/golden/v_carve_letter_l.cl` is new. I read it line by line. The depths agree with the cone law. Example: `Feed 4992 -4008 7002` has rho 1.008 mm, so the depth is 1.008 - 0.01 = 0.998 mm under Z8. The corner rides go up to Z8 at the convex corners (`-2000 7000 8000`, `-6000 7000 8000`). No existing golden changed.
- No `CHANGELOG.md` edit, no snapshot PNG, no new dependency, no process file.

### Results merged with main (locally)

The trial merge with `upstream/main` at `aa4c785db` is clean. Everything ran locally (macOS). No runner was used.

- Quick gate, motion steps: 43 steps, 0 failed (`v_carve`, `machining2d`, `shape_masks`, `rest2d`, `offset_shells` included).
- Quick gate, sim steps and `cl suites: headless_bin`: 36 steps, 0 failed.
- Quick gate, post steps: 48 steps, 0 failed.
- App suites (a targeted subset of the quick plan, 32 suites, 0 failed): `lib`, `v_carve_op` (7/7), `coarse_laws`, `ribbon`, `engrave_law`, `mark_floor`, `golden_cl`, `project_roundtrip`, `operations`, `section_mode`, `setup_sheet`, `mill2d_b`, `mill2d_c`, `wall_column_gouge`, `wall_arc_entry`, `solid_law_goldens`, `solid_law`, `keep_law`, `commands_undo`, `mcp`, `mcp_generate`, `mcp_verify`, `posting`, `sim`, `stock_sim_document`, `verify`, `heights`, `tool_law`, `units_in_refusals`, `setup_align_2d_kinds`, `tilt_basis_compat`, `post_not_judged`.
- The other app suites of the quick plan (about 560) did not run in this review. The author reports the full quick gate green on this head (782 steps).
- UI: `ui build`, `ui suites: lib`, `ui suites: operations`: green.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Heavy lanes: not run (see item 2).

**Extra suites run:** no file under `testdata/` changed, and no import code changed. The one new file in a fixture directory is the golden. The suites that the gate maps to `tests/golden/` (`wall_arc_entry`, `wall_column_gouge`, `golden_cl`) ran and are green.

### Mutations (re-run by the reviewer)

1. `link_ok` in `vcarve_walk.rs` always returns `true`: `the_cone_never_leaves_the_region` is red. Restored: green. Note: `degenerate_regions_give_a_clean_answer` stays green with this mutation. The fuzz test does not catch a missing link check.
2. `VCarve` removed from `is_mark_kind` in `mark_law.rs`: `a_letter_is_carved_verified_simulated_and_posted` and `over_mcp_a_letter_is_carved_verified_and_undone` are red. Restored: green.

### Requested before merge

1. **A legal V-carve deeper than the bit radius is refused as a gouge.** `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:3290` and `crates/app/src/stock_sim.rs:355` give the mark budget `min(Top - Bottom, diameter / 2)`. A V-carve cuts to `radius / tan(angle / 2)`. For a V-bit with an included angle under 90 degrees, the cone is higher than the bit radius. Then a correct carve is deeper than the budget.
   - Probe (local only, not pushed): a 20 x 20 mm square part, 8 mm high. A 10 mm V-bit at 60 degrees, flute 12 mm. Maximum depth 6 mm. The cone radius at the top is 6 x tan 30 = 3.46 mm, so the cut stays far inside the region. Result: 20 `Gouge` warnings, and the post is blocked.
   - At a maximum depth of 4.9 mm with the same tool: 0 warnings. At 90 degrees, 4 mm: 0 warnings. So the cause is the budget, not the path.
   - 60 degree V-bits are the usual tool for sign carving. Give the V-carve a budget from its cone (for example `min(Top - Bottom, cone height)`), in the two places. Add a pinning test with an angle under 90 degrees and a depth over the bit radius.
2. **The heavy lanes that the diff reaches did not run.** Upstream `AGENTS.md`, "Heavy lanes at review" (#2568): a PR whose diff reaches a heavy lane is not ready while a reached heavy test is not run. `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` lists 237 steps for this diff (the `motion` and `app` heavy lanes). The PR body says that they did not run. Run `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` on the final head. Name the lanes and their results in the PR body.
3. **No before and after screenshots for the UI change.** The PR adds a page (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/vcarve_page.rs`), an icon (`assets/ui/op-v-carve.png`) and menu rows. The body says: "The UI page was not driven by hand." Add screenshots of the V-Carve page tabs (Geometry, Heights, Passes, Feeds) and of the icon in the operation menu or tree. Put the images on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch and link them from the PR body. Do not commit images to the PR branch.

### Questions and notes (not blocking)

- **The link check is sampled, and the sim does not back it up.** `link_ok` (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/vcarve_walk.rs`, the last function of the file) tests the distance at points up to 0.25 mm apart, with a slack of 0.25 x `ALLOW` (0.0025 mm). The distance to the outline is 1-Lipschitz, and rho changes along the move. Between two samples, the cone can come nearer to a reflex corner than the samples show. The decision record says that the check holds "without trust in the sampling", but the check itself is sampled. `Mode::Carve` stands down the region laws in the sim, and the mark budget covers a shallow overcut. So the generator is the only guard. I did not find a failing case. Recommendation: add the Lipschitz margin to the test (half the sample spacing times `1 + |d rho / ds|`), or measure the segment against each outline edge exactly. A follow-up issue is sufficient.
- The fuzz test `degenerate_regions_give_a_clean_answer` stays green when `link_ok` is removed (mutation 1). An assert of the cone sweep in that test would make it a safety pin too.
- The new page has no layout test in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/page_layout.rs`. The kind fields share the operation page, so this is not required. A structural assertion for the V-Carve labels would help.
- #3058 also takes kind tag 44. The PR that merges second must renumber. The decision record says this.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: all three requested changes from the latest review.

1. Both V-Carve mark budgets now use the cone height. The pin is `a_sixty_degree_carve_deeper_than_the_bit_radius_is_legal`. It cuts 6 mm with a 10 mm, 60-degree V-bit. It checks generation, stock simulation and posting. The old generation budget gives 20 Gouge warnings: red. Restore the fix: green. The old simulation budget gives 84 gouge cells: red. Restore the fix: green.
2. The reached `motion` and `app` heavy lanes ran on the final head. All 236 steps completed. The gate is green with zero unexpected failures. Six registered probes failed as expected for #1950 and #2849. The PR body names each probe. The quick gate is green: 782 steps, zero failures. Clippy is clean for motion, sim, app and UI.
3. The PR body links before and after screenshots of Geometry, Heights, Passes and Feeds. Each image shows the V-Carve tree icon. The images are on the fork's images-only [pr-screenshots branch](https://github.com/mkinney/Camcraft/tree/88806fb3eeb7ba4177e6171ebfd63d65e24069d7/pr-3151). No image is on the PR branch. The screenshots render the shipping UI offscreen. Native mouse interaction was not exercised.

New head: `81aef5ab2935da80e6ebbe517216d4ccafe032bc`.

Please review this head again.

**Needs changes before merge.**

This is a SAFETY-tier review. The PR changes geometry, verification, stock simulation and posted G-code.

### Requested before merge

1. **A legal deep V-Carve from stock still cannot post.** `crates/app/src/operation/mark_law.rs:86` introduces the cone-height limit. Generation and stock simulation use it. However, `crates/app/src/operation/kept_rejudge.rs:93` still limits the live mark check to `job.tool.diameter * 0.5`. The post runs this check even when stock simulation is clean (`crates/app/src/posting_sim.rs:121`).

   I changed only the source in the existing 60-degree test helper from `whole()` to `SrcRef::Stock`. The part and stock remain 20 x 20 x 8 mm. The tool remains 10 mm wide, with a 60-degree angle and 12 mm flute. The requested depth remains 6 mm. Generation gives no blocking warning. Stock simulation gives zero gouge cells. Posting then fails:

   ```text
   a deep legal V-carve posts: post blocked - V1 now cuts part 'part' (move 3 cuts past the finish surface) - a part moved, added or no longer workholding since it was generated; regenerate it
   ```

   No part moved. The live check uses a 5 mm limit instead of the cone height. Use `cutter_depth_limit(&job.params, &job.tool)` in the live check too. Add a stock-source case to the pin. Keep the existing part-source case. I restored the temporary test change after the probe.

2. **The PR conflicts with the newer main.** The final check reports `CONFLICTING`. A local `git merge-tree` confirms conflicts against `upstream/main` at `ced4dc34e743b75a2e6d7836c998dcc5f2c1fa79` in these files:

   - `crates/app/src/operation/kinds.rs` (the appended kind row at line 2457).
   - `crates/app/src/operation/mod.rs`.
   - `crates/app/src/operation/tests.rs`.
   - `crates/app/src/operation/types/sel.rs`.
   - `crates/app/tests/coarse_laws.rs`.
   - `crates/app/tests/ribbon.rs`.
   - `crates/motion/src/machining2d/mod.rs`.
   - `crates/sim/src/verify/crossing.rs`.
   - `crates/sim/src/verify/reach.rs`.
   - `crates/sim/src/verify/section.rs`.

   Resolve these conflicts when the branch is refreshed. Keep the kind declaration, row and tag in the same order. Run the required checks on the refreshed head. The green results below apply to the clean trial merge with `bd63d15c2`, not this newer main. I made no conflict resolution.

### Earlier findings

- The generation and simulation budgets now use the cone height. The existing 60-degree pin passes. Both independent budget mutations fail as expected.
- The body now reports the final-head heavy gate: 236 steps in the `motion` and `app` lanes. It reports 57 motion tests and 43 app tests passed, with six registered probes failing as expected for #1950 and #2849. I did not rerun the full heavy lanes. These are author results, not a verdict on my newer trial merge.
- I opened all eight linked screenshots. They show Geometry, Heights, Passes, Feeds and the tree icon before and after the review correction. They are on the fork's images branch. No screenshot or review evidence was added to the PR branch. The body identifies the captures as offscreen renders. Native mouse interaction was not exercised.

### Local build and tests

The trial merge with `upstream/main` as fetched at the start, at `bd63d15c2fd1ab69a566fb7f12c18c4a3b427b7b` is clean. All reviewer commands ran locally on Linux. No GitHub runner was used.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: **805 steps passed, zero failed**, in 58.6 minutes. Suite steps: CL 1; post 47; simulation 34; motion 76; app 628; UI 14. The five other steps built test targets.
- `v_carve`: **11 passed**, including the cone sweep. `v_carve_op`: **8 passed**, including the 60-degree pin, the low-Top refusal, MCP, undo, save/load and the CL golden.
- UI library: **1,390 passed, zero failed, seven ignored**. The UI suites ran from `crates/ui`.
- `cargo clippy -j 32 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: **passed**.
- `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main`: **three steps passed, zero failed**. Both motion light tests passed in release. Wall time: 3.9 minutes.
- An earlier broad gate attempt stopped with signal 15 at `adaptive_entry_pieces`. It gave no verdict. The complete green run above replaces it.

### Mutations rerun by the reviewer

1. Restore the radius limit at generation: the 60-degree pin fails with **20 `Gouge` warnings**. Restore the cone-height call: **green**.
2. Restore the radius limit at stock simulation: the same pin fails with **84 gouge cells**, worst **0.936760 mm**. Restore the cone-height call: **green**. The full eight-test app suite also passes after restoration.

### Extra suites run

The diff adds `crates/app/tests/golden/v_carve_letter_l.cl`. I searched for readers of that directory, including shared helpers. The reader suites below ran by name within the complete quick gate and passed. The kernel importer extras do not apply: no importer, STEP fixture or `testdata/` file changed.

```
app: adaptive_trochoid, altmill_machines, arc_entry, c_axis_live, c_axis_unwind, carvera_post, circular_stay_down, conformance, contour_start_point, control_comp, corner_relief, golden_cl, grblhal_post, lathe_post, lathe_post_css, lathe_post_g76, lathe_post_g76_schedule, lathe_post_inch, lathe_post_thread_dips, lathe_post_tormach, lathe_post_tormach_g76_ladder, lathe_post_tormach_thread, microarc_test_part, plasma_post, plasma_post_refusals, pocket3d_trochoid, pocket_no_adaptive, post_cycle_feed_spindle, probe_op, program_comments, program_entry, program_units, rest_pocket, sinker_burn, sinker_orbit, sinker_side, sinker_undersize, sinker_wear, sodick_wire_dielectric, sodick_wire_passes, sodick_wire_post, solid_law_goldens, stock_engine_agreement, stock_field_cost, thread_boss, thread_mill, tinyg_post, tormach_end_units, tormach_fourth_axis, tormach_machines, tormach_post, v_carve_op, wall_arc_entry, wall_column_gouge, wear_comp, wire_4axis, wire_burnout, wire_post, wire_tabs, wire_taper, wire_taper_angle
post: arc_planes, doosan_dnm_post, explain_remaining, explain_tormach, fanuc_post, grbl_dialect, heidenhain_block_form, heidenhain_cycles, inverted_post, post_engine, script_sinker_iso, script_sinker_side, work_offset_index, recorded_streams, lib
cl: headless_bin
```

### Other checks

I read all 118 lines of the new CL golden. The depths, corner rises, floor rings and final retract agree with the fixture. No existing golden changed. The kind declaration, row and tag append at 44. The page edits the draft through the existing command flow. The new modules name their public sources. No dependency, build script, workflow, process file or release snapshot changed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
